subject: Security & hosting: recommended pathing, evidence owners, and sprint plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Porter <jamie.porter@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Sep 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Security & hosting: recommended pathing, evidence owners, and sprint plan

Jamie — thanks for the time today. Quick written recap and concrete next steps so we all have visibility.

Key constraints we heard on the call:
- Aurelia will process PHI in production (EHR-derived notes + user-submitted data).
- You require an executed BAA for any environment with PHI.
- SOC2 Type II evidence and a crisp audit window (logs, retention, and access controls) are gating items for Prod go/no-go.
- Preference expressed: Private VPC for Prod if the timeline and procurement allow; willing to consider Dedicated host if it speeds time-to-value.

My recommended pathing (low friction -> full compliance production):
1) Short pilot: Hosted API + isolated dedicated capacity (sandbox) for functional validation (2–4 weeks).
   - Pros: fastest to start, no infra onboarding; Cons: isolated but not customer-managed network.
2) Pre-prod: Dedicated capacity behind a BAA with enhanced logging and retention (4–6 weeks).
   - Pros: predictable throughput, easier security sign-off; Cons: still Redwood-managed infra.
3) Prod: Private VPC (customer-managed) or on-prem (if required by procurement).
   - Pros: maximum control and alignment with strict audit requirements; Cons: longer lead time for infra and SOC attestations, procurement.

Artifacts Redwood can provide (attached where relevant):
- Draft BAA (Redwood-BAA-draft-v1.docx) — please review and flag edits.
- SOC2 summary + scope (SOC2-summary-2026.pdf) — includes controls mapping and auditor contact.
- Audit ask checklist (audit-asklist.xlsx) — concrete list of configs/logs we can export and timelines.

Immediate asks / owners & dates:
- Jamie / Aurelia security: confirm whether Private VPC is required for production or if Dedicated with a signed BAA is acceptable as a stop-gap (reply by 2027-09-10).
- Aurelia procurement: indicate target procurement window so we can align private deployment work (reply by 2027-09-17).
- Redwood: we will drop a BAA draft and SOC2 artifacts (attached). Karthik will own coordinating the technical onboarding; Marissa will own DocuSign and legal coordination; Logan will coordinate infra readiness for Dedicated and Private options.

Next meeting proposal: 30-min security walkthrough with Aurelia Security + Redwood infra owners — propose Wed 9/14 or Thu 9/15. Please call out availability.

Attachments: Redwood-BAA-draft-v1.docx, SOC2-summary-2026.pdf, audit-asklist.xlsx

Thanks — short and actionable.

—
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0197
https://redwood.ai

From: Jamie Porter <jamie.porter@aureliahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aurelia Security Team <security@aureliahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Sep 2027 09:12:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Security & hosting: recommended pathing, evidence owners, and sprint plan

Thanks Karthik — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Private VPC is our preferred target for production. If Dedicated behind a signed BAA can be approved as an interim step (for the pilot and pre-prod) that could work, but procurement will need a clear migration plan to Private.
2) SOC2 Type II report: we need auditor attestation for the last 12 months (PDF). The SOC2 summary is helpful but we may require the full report under an NDA — can you confirm Redwood's policy?
3) Log retention: we need at least 90 days of immutable access logs and an exportable audit trail for the audit window. Is that supported in Dedicated and Private?
4) Timing: procurement target is end of Q4 (2027-12-31) for Prod. Pilot can start earlier if the BAA is signed and we have the audit artifacts.

Can you also confirm which artifacts Aurelia must provide for Private VPC onboarding (IP allowlist, VPN termination certs, contact points)?

If you can address these items we can lock down the mutual action plan. Also, we'll route the BAA to our legal and security review once we get the draft.

—
Jamie Porter
Director, Product Security
Aurelia Health
jamie.porter@aureliahealth.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Porter <jamie.porter@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Sep 2027 11:45:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Security & hosting: recommended pathing, evidence owners, and sprint plan

Jamie — good questions. Responses inline below and a concrete MAP (mutual action plan) at the end.

1) SOC2 Type II report: Redwood can share the full SOC2 Type II report under NDA. Our SOC2 attestation covers the Redwood inference platform (control domains listed in the SOC2 summary). I'll loop Legal if you want the full PDF — Marissa will own the NDA/DocuSign flow.

2) Log retention: Dedicated and Private both support configurable retention; default exports and immutable logs are available. For Dedicated we can guarantee 90 days retention and provide an export in the audit window. For Private VPC, retention is customer-configurable and we can provide guidance and exporter scripts as part of the onboarding.

3) Artifacts from Aurelia for Private onboarding:
   - IP allowlist and VPN termination endpoints / certs
   - Primary infra contact + IAM owner for onboarding work
   - Procurement timelines and PO contact (for Dedicated or Private contracts)

Mutual action plan (high level):
- 2027-09-10: Aurelia confirms "Dedicated as interim OK" vs "Private required for Prod" (owner: Jamie).
- 2027-09-14: Security walkthrough (30m) — Redwood infra + Aurelia security (owners: Karthik / Logan).
- 2027-09-17: Aurelia procurement provides target procurement window and PO contact (owner: Aurelia procurement).
- 2027-09-20: Redwood sends NDA + SOC2 full report (if requested) and updated BAA (owner: Marissa).
- 2027-09-27: Kickoff for pilot (Hosted + Dedicated sandbox) if BAA signed and preliminary artifacts provided (owners: Logan / Aurelia infra).

Attachments included again: Redwood-BAA-draft-v1.docx, SOC2-summary-2026.pdf, audit-asklist.xlsx

If that MAP looks right I'll schedule the security walkthrough for Tue 9/14 at 10am PT and send calendar invites. Let me know if Tue doesn’t work.

Onwards —
Karthik

Looping back with owners and immediate actions from Redwood side: 

- DocuSign / Legal: I will drop the NDA and BAA into DocuSign by EOD today (owner: Marissa). Expect a short cover note describing purpose and requested signers.
- SOC2 / Auditor: I'll coordinate with our auditor to prep the full SOC2 Type II PDF for sharing under NDA (owner: Marissa; ETA 9/20).
- Infra: Logan — please prepare a Dedicated sandbox provisioning checklist and confirm 90-day immutable log export is enabled by default. Share the checklist link in thread.
- Scheduling: Karthik — please confirm the Tue 9/14 10:00 PT slot for the security walkthrough; if attendees prefer another time we can shift.

Quick notes for Logan: for Private onboarding we will need a template for VPN cert exchange and a mapping of which ports/services we open; include example Terraform snippets if possible so the Aurelia infra team has a head start.

Marissa
